title: fix(web): prevent race when editing album description during upload
body:
## Description

Fixes a race condition where editing an album's description while files are uploading causes the description change to be silently dropped.

When both events fire close together — (1) the user saves a description edit and (2) the upload completes and fires `AlbumAddAssets` — the `onAlbumAddAssets` handler calls `refreshAlbum()` to fetch the latest album state from the server. If the description save hasn't yet been committed to the database, the server returns stale data, overwriting the optimistic description update with `null`.

This PR replaces the `refreshAlbum()` call in `onAlbumAddAssets` with a local `assetCount` update. The `onAlbumUpdate` handler already fetches authoritative state from the server, so the redundant server fetch was both unnecessary and race-prone.

Fixes #31746

## How Has This Been Tested?

Manual verification:
1. Open an album with 0 assets
2. Start uploading files while the progress bar is visible
3. Open the edit modal and set a description, then click Save
4. Verify the description persists after the upload completes
5. Verify `assetCount` updates correctly
